note: Per-seat subscription plans for ClearGlass Workspace. Server-side price authority: the browser names a plan SKU and a seat count, and only this file (and, in live mode, the Stripe Price it points at) decides the amount charged. `unit_amount` is the price for ONE seat for ONE billing period — for annual plans that is twelve months paid at once, so it is the monthly rate times twelve. Keep in step with the PLANS object in workspace.html; tests/test_workspace.py pins the two together.

plans.name: ClearGlass Workspace Essentials — monthly
plans.description: Business email on your own domain, encrypted file storage and sharing, shared calendars and contacts, browser documents, mobile access, spam filtering and account security. Billed monthly, per person.
